title: Sharp sixth-norm comparison
statement: Let $a,b\in\mathbb R$. For a uniformly chosen sign $\varepsilon\in\{-1,1\}$, the sixth-norm of $a+\sqrt{1/5}\,b\varepsilon$ is at most the $2$-norm of $a+b\varepsilon$.
